failures.title: BMW B47D20D Engine Problems - What Actually Fails

items.title: EGR Cooler Cracking and Coolant Leaks - 2014-2019 models
items.whatHappens: The B47D20D is subject to a known weakness in the EGR cooler, which can develop micro-cracks and allow coolant to leak into the exhaust system or intake. In severe cases, this creates a potential fire risk, prompting BMW to issue a widespread service recall (SIB 11 09 15) for affected vehicles.
items.repairVsReplace: While the cooler can be replaced independently (£600-£1,200), if the coolant ingress has caused hydrolock or severe internal corrosion, a full BMW B47D20D engine replacement is the only safe option. Read our full EGR and swirl flap failure guide.

items.title: Turbocharger Wastegate and Actuator Wear - Bi-Turbo (25d) variants
items.whatHappens: In the higher-output 25d applications, the B47D20D utilises a sequential bi-turbo setup. The low-pressure turbo's wastegate actuator and linkage are prone to wear and rattle, leading to boost leaks, limp mode, and excessive smoke.
items.repairVsReplace: A standalone turbo rebuild or replacement is often sufficient (£1,200-£2,500). However, if turbo failure has sent debris into the intercooler or engine, a full reconditioned B47D20D unit is recommended to prevent immediate secondary failure.

items.title: Swirl Flap and Intake Carbon Buildup
items.whatHappens: Like most modern direct-injection diesels, the B47D20D suffers from carbon accumulation in the intake manifold, which can cause the swirl flap motor to fail or the flaps to stick, resulting in poor throttle response and DPF regeneration issues.
items.repairVsReplace: This is typically repairable via intake manifold cleaning, swirl flap deletion, or EGR system servicing, and does not usually necessitate a full BMW B47D20D engine replacement on its own.

failures.goodYearsLine: The B47D20D is generally considered a significant improvement over the N47 it replaced, with a front-mounted timing chain that largely eliminates the catastrophic rear-chain failures of the previous generation.

variants.title: How to Confirm You Have the BMW B47D20D

relatives.description: The N47D20D it replaced suffered from catastrophic rear timing chain failures, which the B47 largely resolved by moving the chain to the front of the engine.
The later B47TU2 evolution introduced further refinements to the emissions and cooling systems, addressing some of the early Euro 6 teething issues found in the B47D20D.

variants.closing: The B47D20D is a specific Euro 6 calibration of the broader B47 family, most commonly found in the higher-output '20d' and '25d' badges of the mid-2010s lineup. It is frequently confused with the slightly lower-output [B47D20A](/bmw/b47d20a-engine/) or the updated [B47TU](/bmw/b47tu-engine/) variants. You can confirm your exact engine code by checking the sticker on the engine block (typically near the oil filter housing or timing cover), reviewing your V5C registration document, or performing a quick VIN decode. Fitting the wrong revision - particularly confusing a single-turbo B47D20A with a bi-turbo B47D20D - will result in ECU mismatch, incorrect boost levels, and immediate limp mode. Not sure? Enter your registration above - we'll confirm your exact B47D20D fitment before any quotes are sent.

buyingGuide.title: Buying a Replacement BMW B47D20D - What to Choose

options.label: Used
options.body: A used BMW B47D20D engine is only advisable if the seller can provide documented proof that the EGR cooler recall was completed and the turbochargers have been recently serviced. Without this history, the risk of inheriting a cracked cooler or worn wastegate is too high. Learn more about sourcing used engines.

options.label: Reconditioned
options.body: A proper reconditioned BMW B47D20D is the most balanced choice for most owners. A quality rebuild will install the updated, reinforced EGR cooler, replace the turbo actuators, and refresh all seals and gaskets, effectively eliminating the engine's primary design weaknesses. Explore reconditioned engines.

options.label: Rebuilt
options.body: A full rebuild is justified if the original B47D20D suffered catastrophic failure due to coolant ingestion or turbo debris. An upgraded rebuild should include a fully balanced rotating assembly and the latest revision of the EGR and turbo components to prevent recurrence. View rebuilt engines.

buyingGuide.supplyFitLine: Buying through our network ensures your replacement BMW B47D20D is installed by vetted UK specialists, backed by a minimum 12-month warranty, with nationwide delivery options for both supply-only and full supply & fit packages.
buyingGuide.vehicleValueNote: The B47D20D is commonly found in F-series models like the 320d, 420d, and X1 xDrive20d, which typically hold a market value of £7,000-£20,000 depending on age and condition. Because the replacement cost is generally well within the vehicle's retained value, a reconditioned engine is usually a financially sound investment, though sub-£5,000 examples should be evaluated carefully against scrap or part-exchange alternatives.
